content: Expertise reversal effect (Kalyuga et al.): worked examples and heavy scaffolding help novices but actively hurt learners as prior knowledge grows -- the same guidance that helps early becomes redundant cognitive load later and slows advanced learners relative to unaided problem solving. Implication: hint/support level should fade with demonstrated mastery, not stay fixed; a fixed hint ladder for every learner at every skill level is itself a design smell.
